title: One row per requirement in the brief, with its blocking gate and the number that clears it

statuses.met: built here, source-linked, and gated by an automated check
statuses.partial: partially built here; the missing part is named in blocking_gate
statuses.blocked: cannot be built from an official source available to this namespace; the clearing number is stated
statuses.not-started-here: deliberately out of this namespace's scope; not claimed (peer namespaces may hold it)
statuses.not-this-namespace: owned by the availability namespaces; not re-published here
statuses.rejected-as-specified: the brief itself rejects it, or it is rejected in the pre-registration

rows.requirement: Add a price-snapshot store that records opening and closing numbers for every market we originate
rows.built: Two dated snapshots per fixture (open = model through week 9, update = through week 10) for side, total and moneyline; the market column exists and is blank.
rows.clearing_number: any citable official or licensed price archive

rows.requirement: Add a verified results feed so backtests and ROI can be computed
rows.built: 148 games, weeks 1-10, every row transcribed from the official week page and every club record re-derived and checked against the official standings page (160 club-fields, 0 mismatches).

rows.requirement: Originate the side first, then the total, then the moneyline
rows.built: Every fixture carries origination_order = [side, total, moneyline] and the build fails if the order changes.

rows.requirement: Publish the model's fair line, the market line, and the difference as separate columns
rows.built: Fair line and fair total and fair moneyline are published per fixture per snapshot; the market and difference columns render blank with the reason on the row.

rows.requirement: Separate 'signal' from 'staking' in the leaderboard so a lucky staking run cannot mask a bad signal
rows.built: Two stages: stage 1 ranks only proper scores (Brier skill with a week-cluster lower bound), stage 2 shows staking with the price printed on every row and ranked=false.

rows.requirement: Track the depth of the replacement, not just the fact of a replacement
rows.built: Nothing is published: this namespace holds no depth rank or snap count for any club, and does not infer one from jersey number, salary, experience or draft slot.
rows.clearing_number: a verified depth rank or official snap counts for 32 of 32 clubs

rows.requirement: Compute correlations only from officially sourced numbers and publish n with each value
rows.built: 4 correlations computed on official scores/dates, each with n, p and a Fisher-z interval; a fifth shows group means with n and prints no r because n = 8.

rows.requirement: Define a demotion gate that sends a live strategy back to paper
rows.built: G7 is written: a live strategy failing G2 for 4 consecutive weeks returns to paper. No strategy is live, so the gate has nothing to demote — which is the honest state, not a pass.
rows.clearing_number: one live strategy to exercise it

rows.requirement: Pre-register every strategy; forbid backtest numbers from ever appearing on the leaderboard
rows.built: PREREGISTRATION.md is committed (a4f26f5) before any number was computed, and names every strategy and every gate. The leaderboard's stage 1 shows proper scores; the build fails if a return figure is rendered there.

rows.requirement: Build the availability graph as a first-class dataset (who was expected to start, who actually did)
rows.built: Not built here. The official injury report gives a game status, not a starter list, and no official inactive list or game book was read by this namespace.
rows.clearing_number: 32 clubs x 18 weeks of official game books, or one official inactive feed

rows.requirement: Do not model depth from jersey order; model it from playing time
rows.built: Rejected explicitly: neither jersey order nor playing time is available from an official source in this repository, so no depth model is fitted at all.

rows.requirement: Make the injury signal a surprise, never a level
rows.built: Not built: a surprise needs a prior expectation (a depth chart) and a realised outcome (an inactive list). This namespace has neither, so it publishes no injury feature.
rows.clearing_number: one archived weekly report series plus inactive lists

rows.requirement: Run the 32-team roster/IR sweep before any team-level model is trusted
rows.built: The team-level model here is trusted only for the ratings page, and its forecasts are gated by G1/G2. No roster sweep was run by this namespace.
rows.clearing_number: 32 club roster pages read line by line, dated

rows.requirement: Add a fixture-context feature set built only from published schedule facts
rows.built: Date, kickoff, network, the printed section (which is how the international flag is sourced), rest days from printed dates, and venue from the game centre — all per fixture.

rows.requirement: Store every model output as a probability plus its inputs, not just a pick
rows.built: 116 walk-forward rows + 26 Week 11 snapshot rows, each carrying p, mu, hfa, sigma, both clubs' ratings, the cutoff week and the training count.

rows.requirement: Compute and publish the 'removal of luck' panel on the site dashboard
rows.built: Five registered luck tests: label-shuffle placebo, coin-flip counterfactual, week-cluster bootstrap, half-sample persistence, and a fade control. All five are on the dashboard.

rows.requirement: Add a two-sided 'what would change our mind' field to every strategy entry
rows.built: Every strategy row carries both directions: what would promote it and what would demote it, with the number attached.

rows.requirement: Price a line ourselves and publish the residual against the market, on a schedule, from day one
rows.built: The pricing side is published (two dated snapshots, 13 fixtures, three markets). The residual is not, because there is no official market number to subtract.

rows.requirement: Turn the 136-game log into the pre-registered backtest corpus
rows.built: The official week pages print 16+16+16+16+15+14+14+14+15 = 136 FINAL games across weeks 1-9, which is exactly the brief's log, and 12 more in week 10 (two week-10 games were still unplayed at the read), for 148. The pre-registered corpus is the 136-game log, and the walk-forward window extends to 148 because those 12 games are also official and final.

rows.requirement: Decide the price-data policy before any backtest is published
rows.built: Policy is stated in the pre-registration before the backtest: no official price exists, so ROI is reported only at a labelled assumed price and is never ranked.

rows.requirement: Store every injury-hub read with its clock time and publish the delta, never the level
rows.built: This namespace read no injury page, so it publishes no injury level and no delta. Peer namespaces hold the dated captures; this page links to them rather than copying them.

rows.requirement: Put a decision-readiness table on the landing page: one row per requirement, with the gate that blocks it and the number that would clear it
rows.built: The landing page is that table.

rows.requirement: Transcribe the venue of every fixture from the official game centre and publish it
rows.built: 13 of 13 Week 11 fixtures, city and stadium exactly as printed, each with its game-centre URL.

rows.requirement: Publish the league's dated schedule announcement beside the live schedule page
rows.built: The live schedule statement is linked and cited. A dated league announcement of the 2026 schedule was not read by this namespace, so it is not quoted.

rows.requirement: Use official NFL Game Books for actual starters and game-day status
rows.built: No game book was read. Nothing on this site is derived from one.
rows.clearing_number: one official game book PDF per game

rows.requirement: Ingest game-level results to make the ratings opponent-aware
rows.built: The ratings solve a two-sided system in which a club's offence is measured only through what it did against the defences it actually faced.

rows.requirement: Add injury and personnel ablations instead of fixed penalties
rows.built: No ablation is run, because there is no availability feature to ablate. No fixed penalty for a missing starter exists anywhere in this namespace.

rows.requirement: Automate immutable multi-day availability snapshots
rows.built: Out of scope for this namespace by design (no scheduled collector, no writes outside nfl-sources/). Peer namespaces hold the dated captures; the gap is real and is not claimed as closed.

rows.requirement: Fix the two depth-parsing failures before widening coverage
rows.built: This namespace never parsed a depth chart, so it cannot have broken one.

rows.requirement: Model depth slots as groups, not a single starter
rows.built: Not modelled here at all (see R06).
rows.clearing_number: a depth source that preserves ties

rows.requirement: Treat roster turnover as a first-class data event
rows.built: This namespace keys nothing to a roster version. Peer namespaces document two Week-10 trades; this page links to that evidence rather than restating it.
rows.clearing_number: a dated transactions feed joined to depth rows

rows.requirement: Start with a singles-only shadow baseline
rows.built: S1 is a singles-only shadow baseline: every forecast is recorded before kickoff and graded after, and no money is modelled.

rows.requirement: Keep parlays and prop combos behind a joint-evidence gate
rows.built: G6 blocks them: no joint probability has been validated and no operator void/push rules are available, so no parlay is ranked.

rows.requirement: Use proper-score leaderboard divisions
rows.built: The leaderboard has one division (singles) because that is the only division with any graded rows. Game parlays, same-game parlays and prop combos have 0 rows each and say so.
rows.clearing_number: at least one joint evidence set

rows.requirement: Rank with proper scores and uncertainty, not win rate
rows.built: Ranking is by Brier skill with a week-cluster lower bound; accuracy is shown but never ranks, and the page shows why (the record-only control scores 0.652 accuracy).

rows.requirement: Add durable snapshot storage and alerts
rows.built: Out of scope here. What this namespace does instead: every input is hashed in data/provenance.json so a silent edit to a transcription is detectable.

rows.requirement: Split the site into a public analysis layer and a private data layer
rows.built: This site publishes derived analysis (lines, probabilities, scores, correlations). Row-level raw data is limited to final scores, which are public facts quoted from the official page; no proprietary feed, no scraped availability data, and no player-level data are committed.

rows.requirement: Add a per-team view: starters out, replacements named, net injury count
rows.built: Not published: this namespace has no starters-out column it can verify.

rows.requirement: Add an announced-starter evidence field (not an inferred replacement)
rows.built: Not attempted here; the field needs the official announcements, which this namespace did not read.

rows.requirement: Add an official depth-chart register with date and source per row
rows.built: Not attempted here.

rows.requirement: Calibrate what 'Questionable' means empirically instead of using old percentages
rows.built: The reliability bins published here are for the MODEL's probabilities, not for a designation. The designation calibration needs archived reports joined to inactive lists.
rows.clearing_number: 3+ seasons of reports joined to inactive lists

rows.requirement: Interactive offence-vs-defence deficiency matrix (1st-4th string)
rows.built: Not built: it requires a depth rank per club, which does not exist in this repository. Building it from anything else would fabricate starters.
rows.clearing_number: 32 clubs x a verified depth source

rows.requirement: Flag stale depth rows against the official transactions log
rows.built: No depth rows exist here to be stale.

rows.requirement: Point-in-time snapshot ledger for injuries, depth charts and inactives
rows.built: This namespace's point-in-time ledger covers forecasts only: every forecast row records its cutoff week and is checked by G3 (mutating later results changes no earlier forecast).

rows.requirement: Populate the three missing Lions game-status designations
rows.built: The peer capture is the record here; this namespace does not re-publish injury rows, so it neither confirms nor contradicts it. The live report was read once while checking a different claim; see FL-04.

rows.requirement: Re-capture and republish the Week 10 injury tables
rows.built: Owned by the availability namespaces; see FL-04 for one observation made here.

rows.requirement: Reject: deriving depth order from jersey number, experience or salary
rows.built: Rejected in the pre-registration and in the code: no such derivation exists in this package.

rows.built: Not built; no designation history here.

rows.built: Out of scope here.

rows.requirement: Stadium roof/surface and NWS hourly wind/precipitation overlay

rows.built: Two total estimators are published with their gap: (a) the fitted total, (b) the fitted total under the ridge-identified level split. The gap is published per fixture and neither is collapsed.

rows.requirement: Add a drift alarm to every scraper

rows.requirement: Split data into train, validation and final holdout seasons
